name: Google Search
scenario: Give a research agent current web evidence
prompt: Use Google search to find current guidance on evaluating retrieval-augmented generation. Make one search with num 5, then summarize three findings with returned source URLs. Do not claim to have read full pages.
inputs: query; optional gl, hl, location, num/page 1–100, tbs, autocorrect
outputs: results[].organic: title, link, snippet, position; usage.credits
limits: Search snippets are not fetched page content. Omitted count and locale are not filled in by the SDK.
scenarioZh: 为研究 Agent 提供最新网页证据
limitsZh: 搜索片段不等于网页全文；SDK 不替未填写的数量或地区设置默认值。

organic.title: OpenAI | Research & Deployment
organic.snippet: We believe our research will eventually lead to artificial general intelligence, a system that can solve human-level problems.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is OpenAI created by Elon Musk?

name: Google News
prompt: Find recent news about reusable rockets with one Google News search, num 5. Group the returned headlines into themes, link sources, and distinguish publication dates from your inference.
outputs: results[].news: titles, links and available dates/snippets; usage.credits
limits: Returns news search results, not article full text.
scenarioZh: 生成附有来源链接的新闻简报
inputsZh: query；可选 Google 搜索参数
limitsZh: 返回新闻搜索结果，不提取文章全文。

name: Google Images
prompt: Find rooftop solar installation reference images with one Google Images search, num 5. Return available source URLs and dimensions, and flag missing fields. Do not imply reuse rights.
outputs: results[].images: image/source URLs and available dimensions; usage.credits
limits: Does not download images or establish image reuse rights.
scenarioZh: 为视觉调研筛选参考图片
inputsZh: query；可选 Google 搜索参数
limitsZh: 不下载图片，也不授予图片使用权。

name: Google Shopping
prompt: Use one Google Shopping search for USB microphones, num 5. Compare the returned price snapshots and merchants with links. Mark missing prices and do not claim stock or checkout availability.
outputs: results[].shopping: title, link, price and available merchant/rating fields; usage.credits
limits: Prices are search snapshots; inventory and checkout price are not guaranteed.
scenarioZh: 生成产品选购候选清单
inputsZh: query；可选 Google 搜索参数
limitsZh: 价格只是搜索时点快照，不保证库存或结算价格。

outputs: results[].videos: video titles, links and available metadata; usage.credits
limits: Search discovers videos; it does not return video files or transcripts.
inputsZh: query；可选 Google 搜索参数
limitsZh: 只发现视频，不返回媒体文件或字幕。

name: Google Places
scenario: Help an agent shortlist local businesses
prompt: Find coworking spaces in Singapore with one Google Places search, num 5. Summarize available addresses and ratings. Show missing phone numbers as unavailable rather than inventing them.
inputs: query; optional location and other Google search parameters
outputs: results[].places: names and available addresses, ratings and contact fields; usage.credits
limits: Contact details may be missing; verify current hours and availability with the business.
scenarioZh: 让 Agent 筛选本地商家
inputsZh: query；可选 location 和其他 Google 搜索参数
limitsZh: 联系方式可能缺失；营业时间和可用情况需向商家核实。

name: YouTube Search
scenario: Find videos for a research reading list
prompt: Search YouTube once for RAG evaluation tutorials with max_results 5. Return a research shortlist with video URLs and explain what the metadata can and cannot establish.
outputs: results[].results: video search records; totalResults and query; usage.credits
limits: The requested count is a ceiling, not a guaranteed result count.
scenarioZh: 筛选研究主题相关视频
limitsZh: 请求数量是上限，不保证实际返回条数。

name: YouTube Extended Search
scenario: Build a larger video candidate set
prompt: Use one extended YouTube search for retrieval evaluation tutorials with max_results 50. Group the candidate videos by topic, cite video URLs, and do not claim complete coverage.
outputs: results[].results: video search records; totalResults and query; usage.credits
limits: This is a distinct source with a separate higher rate than standard search. Requested count is not guaranteed.
scenarioZh: 建立更大的视频研究候选集
limitsZh: 独立 source，费率高于标准搜索；不保证实际返回条数。

name: YouTube Metadata
scenario: Inspect a video before deeper research
prompt: Inspect YouTube video dQw4w9WgXcQ once, with include_formats false and include_chapters true. Summarize available title, channel, duration, and chapters. Do not invent chapters if absent.
outputs: results[]: videoId, title, channel, duration and other available metadata; usage.credits
limits: Metadata is not media download. Chapters and optional fields may be absent.
scenarioZh: 在深入研究前检查视频信息
limitsZh: 元数据不等于媒体下载；章节及其他可选字段可能缺失。

results.description:
The official video for “Never Gonna Give You Up” by Rick Astley. 

Never: The Autobiography 📚 OUT NOW! 
Follow this link to get your copy and listen to Rick’s ‘Never’ playlist ❤️ #RickAstleyNever
https://linktr.ee/rickastleynever

“Never Gonna Give You Up” was a global smash on its release in July 1987, topping the charts in 25 countries including Rick’s native UK and the US Billboard Hot 100.  It also won the Brit Award for Best single in 1988. Stock Aitken and Waterman wrote and produced the track which was the lead-off single and lead track from Rick’s debut LP “Whenever You Need Somebody”.  The album was itself a UK number one and would go on to sell over 15 million copies worldwide.

The legendary video was directed by Simon West – who later went on to make Hollywood blockbusters such as Con Air, Lara Croft – Tomb Raider and The Expendables 2.  The video passed the 1bn YouTube views milestone on 28 July 2021.

name: YouTube License Metadata
scenario: Inspect license labels before a rights review
prompt: Inspect the license label metadata of YouTube video dQw4w9WgXcQ once. Explain the returned Creative Commons / license signal and explicitly distinguish it from permission to train a model.
outputs: results[]: videoId and license-label indicator permitted, with available kind/etag; usage.credits
limits: permitted is a license-label signal, not legal training permission or creator third-party training settings.
scenarioZh: 在权利审查前检查许可标签
limitsZh: permitted 是许可标签信号，不是训练授权，也不是创作者第三方训练设置。

name: YouTube Channel
prompt: Inspect @GoogleDevelopers once with video_limit 5. Summarize available channel statistics and recent video topics, citing returned channel and video URLs. Do not infer a full publishing history.
outputs: results[]: channelId, channelHandle, name, channelUrl, statistics, videos; usage.credits
limits: A recent-video snapshot is not the complete channel archive.
scenarioZh: 生成频道近期动态简报
limitsZh: 近期视频快照不等于频道完整历史归档。

name: YouTube Autocomplete
scenario: Help a research agent expand a topic
prompt: Get YouTube autocomplete suggestions once for vector database in English, region US. Group the returned suggestions into research themes without inventing search-volume estimates.
inputs: query; language (default en); region (default US, two letters)
limits: Suggestions are not keyword volume or popularity measurements.
scenarioZh: 帮助研究 Agent 扩展主题
inputsZh: query；language 默认 en；region 默认 US（两个字母）
limitsZh: 联想词不是搜索量或热度数据。

name: YouTube Download to Cloud Storage
scenario: Let an agent inspect an asynchronous media delivery
prompt: Read the saved YouTube download job and summarize its current status or delivery manifest. Do not submit any new download.
inputs: submit: video_id, optional format/quality/clip fields; reads: job_id. Storage is server configuration.
outputs: submit: id/status receipt; reads: job lifecycle; completed result: output JSON delivery manifest
limits: Paid asynchronous job. Requires customer storage. Save the receipt; never submit again to poll. Result JSON expires after 24 hours; media retention depends on storage.
scenarioZh: 让 Agent 检查异步媒体交付
inputsZh: 提交：video_id 及可选格式、质量、剪辑参数；读取：job_id。存储配置仅在服务端设置。
limitsZh: 付费异步任务，需要客户存储。保存回执，不要重新提交来轮询。结果 JSON 保留 24 小时，媒体保留期限取决于客户存储。
